name: Tri-Institutional PhD Program in Chemical Biology
summary: Joint chemical biology PhD training at Weill Cornell, Rockefeller and Memorial Sloan Kettering in New York City.

deadlines.label: Entering class of 2027: all materials
deadlines.note: Includes recommendation letters. Selected applicants attend Open House January 18–20, 2027.

english.note: Cambridge English minimum185 also accepted. First-language/citizenship and qualifying English-medium degree exemptions apply; see portal. No new-scale TOEFL conversion stated.

applicationFee.note: Financial hardship, eligible pipeline/recruiting programs or applications to other Tri-Institutional graduate programs. Request in Payment section; international eligibility not explicitly restricted, confirm.

documents: Personal statement, maximum two single-spaced pages, PDF
Transcripts of all undergraduate and graduate studies
Unofficial test score reports if applicable
requirements.note: Main portal permits unofficial transcripts for application; FAQ says official, confirm if needed. Final official transcripts/test reports due June20 after admission. Letters through portal; Interfolio not accepted. Additional external letter strongly encouraged if TPCB faculty recommend. Program normally starts July1; August permitted for extended academic commitments.

funding.note: All TPCB students guaranteed stipend support, subsidized housing, health insurance and annual research allowance. Amount and tuition guarantee not stated in opened program support source.
